protocol.RGB_mask_free_scope: boundary fitting only; frozen upstream state decisions retained
protocol.candidate_scope: lower hull B/U with initial B role, nonS in canvas and two nonS B neighbors
protocol.mask_endpoint_association_warning: 12px normal search + 7px context = 19px retained as warning; fit-only candidates continue
protocol.mask_inputs: sealed actual MobileSAM and TinyUNet outputs; no mask forward or retraining
protocol.boundary_occupancy_masks: both thresholded at fixed .5 before RGB/inside/outside gates; upstream Tiny state scores unchanged
protocol.line_fit_guard: existing RGB guards, minimum branch arc36px, Huber1.25px, finite support11px
protocol.topology_dispatch: initial direction sine >= existing .25: incident local branches; otherwise global unknown-split trace/arc
protocol.V1_comparison_preserved: nonsam_boundary_v1; global unknown-split fits are not appropriate for all stable corners
protocol.scoring: postseal DIRECT/native-compatible 2D intersection diagnostic; coverage and matched subsets
